title: Tight Guarantees for Static Policies in Vehicle Sharing Networks
summary: We study pricing in a vehicle sharing network with $N$ locations and $C$ vehicles, motivated by on-demand bike, scooter, and car sharing, as well as robotaxi and ride sharing services. Customers request directed trips between locations, with travel times following general distributions, and leave without service if no vehicle is available. Pricing affects both demand for trips and the distribution of vehicles across locations. Computing an optimal dynamic pricing policy is challenging because the system state depends on the number of vehicles available at each location and in transit…
